'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
**Five [[Peshmerga]] fighters are killed and four more are wounded during a shooting and bombing attack by the [[Islamic State]] in [[Diyala Governorate|Diyala]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/28/four-peshmerga-wounded-in-isil-attack-in-iraqs-diyala (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020–2021 Ethiopian–Sudanese clashes]]
**Six [[Sudan]]ese [[Sudanese Armed Forces|soldier]]s are killed during a confrontation with [[Ethiopia]]n [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|troops]] in a disputed [[Ethiopia–Sudan border|border]] region. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/28/sudan-military-says-several-soldiers-killed-in-ethiopian-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Operation Barkhane]]
**A [[convoy]] carrying [[France|French]] [[French Armed Forces|troops]] in [[Niger]] opens fire against locals in [[Téra]], [[Tillabéri Region]], who were protesting against the French presence in the country, killing two people and wounding 18 others. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/27/niger-two-killed-and-17-injured-in-clash-with-french-military-convoy (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Northern Peru earthquake]]
**A 7.5 magnitude [[list of earthquakes in Peru|earthquake]] strikes northern [[Peru]] at {{convert|131|km}} of depth, killing one person and injuring 12 others. 75 homes are destroyed and around 220 damaged. The [[earthquake]] is felt as far south as [[Lima]]. [[President of Peru|President]] [[Pedro Castillo]] orders the deployment of relief and also viewed the area in a [[military aircraft]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/peru/2021/11/28/terremoto-en-amazonas-heridos-muertos-viviendas-afectadas-damnificados-sismo-peru-reporte-indeci-coen-defensa-civil/ (Infobae)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] bans foreigners who have travelled to [[South Africa]], [[Botswana]], [[Namibia]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Lesotho]], [[Mozambique]], [[Eswatini]] and [[Nigeria]] in the past 14 days amid the emergence of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]]. [https://www.bbc.com/indonesia/dunia-59449341 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] closes its borders to all foreigners and requires citizens who have travelled outside the country to quarantine for three days for fully [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel|vaccinated]] people and seven days for unvaccinated people as part of an effort to reduce the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211128-israel-closes-borders-to-all-foreigners-over-omicron (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maldives]]
****[[Maldives]] bans entry to flights from [[South Africa]], [[Botswana]], [[Zimbabwe]], [[Mozambique]], [[Namibia]], [[Lesotho]], [[Malawi]] and [[Eswatini]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/maldives-ban-africa-travellers-omicron-covid19-variant-2343431 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] bans entry to flights from [[Austria]], [[Belgium]], the [[Czech Republic]], [[Hungary]], [[Italy]], the [[Netherlands]] and [[Switzerland]]. Additionally, the entry of fully vaccinated foreign nationals from green-list countries that was expected to begin on December 1 is temporarily suspended. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-includes-european-countries-travel-ban-covid-19-omicron (Rappler)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]]
****The [[Morocco|Moroccan]] government announces that it will suspend all incoming passenger flights for the next two weeks. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/28/morocco-suspends-incoming-flights-over-new-covid-variant-omicron (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Rwanda]]
****[[Rwanda]] temporarily suspends all commercial flights to [[Southern Africa]] due to the emergence of the Omicron variant. [https://www.newtimes.co.rw/news/govt-suspends-flights-between-kigali-and-southern-africa (''The New Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
****[[Canada]] reports its first cases of the Omicron variant in two people in [[Ontario]] who recently traveled to Nigeria. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-variant-canada/two-cases-of-omicron-variant-detected-in-canada-govt-says-idUSKBN2ID0Q8 (Reuters)]  
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
***The [[Netherlands]] reports its first cases of the Omicron variant in 13 people who traveled from [[South Africa]] on November 26. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/australia-confirms-omicron-cases-travel-curbs-tighten-81429601 (ABC News)]
***The Netherlands tightens its partial [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] restrictions that require non-essential shops, sports facilities, and hospitality and cultural venues to close at 5 p.m., and chemists, supermarkets, and wholesalers to close at 8 p.m., amid a record number of new COVID-19 cases as well as concerns about the Omicron variant. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59448525 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] reports its first cases of the Omicron variant in two people who travelled from [[Southern Africa]] and are currently in [[quarantine]] in a hotel in [[New South Wales]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-11-28/tavellers-test-positive-omicron-covid-sydney/100657076 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Iranian protests]]
**Sixty-seven protesters are arrested in [[Isfahan]] during a protest against water shortages. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-protests-on-water-shortages-turn-violent-as-police-arrest-67/a-59959075 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Czech legislative election]]
**[[Petr Fiala]] is designated as [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic]] to form a [[Petr Fiala's Cabinet|majority government]] following the [[2021 Czech legislative election|October election]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/czech-republic-petr-fiala-named-new-prime-minister/a-59960529 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[2021 Honduran general election]]
**[[Hondurans]] go to the polls to elect their next [[President of Honduras|President]]. [https://www.npr.org/2021/11/27/1059490234/honduras-holds-presidential-elections-after-difficult-year-for-the-country (NPR)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyz parliamentary election]]
**[[Kyrgyzstan]] holds parliamentary elections after the annulment of the results of the [[2020 Kyrgyz parliamentary election|October 2020 elections]] due to [[2020 Kyrgyzstani protests|protests]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/28/kyrgyzstan-holds-parliamentary-vote-amid-rising-tensions (Al Jazeera)]
*Aftermath of the [[2021 Icelandic parliamentary election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Iceland|Prime Minister]] [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]]'s second cabinet takes office after reaching an agreement with the Left-Green Movement, the Independence Party and the Progressive Party. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/icelands-left-right-coalition-agrees-take-another-term-2021-11-28/ (Reuters)]
